name: Fluid Typing
description: Fixed and animated text or visitor-written text over liquid ripples, with click interaction and palettes for light and dark themes.

controls.name: staticText
controls.label: Static text
controls.description: A fixed prefix displayed alongside the animated, static, or manually entered text.

controls.name: typingMode
controls.label: Typing mode
controls.description: Animate the message, let the visitor type directly, or show the complete text.

controls.name: defaultValue
controls.label: Initial input
controls.description: Initial text for uncontrolled manual input. Replay restores this value.

controls.name: placeholder
controls.label: Input placeholder
controls.description: Prompt shown when the manual input is empty.

controls.name: inputLabel
controls.label: Input label
controls.description: Accessible name of the manual text field.

controls.name: text
controls.label: Text
controls.defaultValue:
Text over a fluid background.
Animated with React Drops.
controls.description: Text to type. A string array creates consecutive lines in the same message.

controls.name: typeSpeed
controls.label: Type speed (ms)
controls.description: Average time between typed characters. Every character emits one wave at the caret.

controls.name: deleteSpeed
controls.label: Delete speed (ms)
controls.description: Time between deleted characters. Deletion emits a weaker wave.

controls.name: holdDuration
controls.label: Hold duration (ms)
controls.description: Hold the complete message before deleting and repeating.

controls.name: introWave
controls.label: Opening wave
controls.description: Start each automatic cycle with one large wave from the lone cursor, then pause before typing.

controls.name: introPause
controls.label: Opening pause (ms)
controls.description: Time between the opening wave and the first character.

controls.name: naturalRhythm
controls.label: Natural rhythm
controls.description: Size every wave by the typing speed: slow keystrokes emit broad, strong waves and quick bursts small, soft ones. Automatic typing also follows a person's uneven rhythm. Turn off for a steady rate with identical waves.

controls.name: autoType
controls.label: Automatic typing
controls.description: Type the text automatically. Turn off to show controlled text directly and emit waves from its changes.

controls.name: loop
controls.label: Loop typing
controls.description: Delete and retype the complete message. Turn off to keep the completed text visible.

controls.name: cursor
controls.label: Cursor
controls.description: Display the blinking text caret. Wave positions still follow its location when hidden.

controls.name: rippleCount
controls.label: Ripple layers
controls.description: Maximum active ripple layers. Each typed character emits a new wave from the caret.

controls.name: rippleWidth
controls.label: Ripple width
controls.description: Width of each ripple before blur, relative to the composition height.

controls.name: rippleSpacing
controls.label: Ripple delay (s)
controls.description: Temporal delay between successive waves in seconds. Increase it to spread their animation timing.

controls.name: centerX
controls.label: Center X
controls.description: Horizontal ripple origin. Zero is the left edge and one is the right edge.

controls.name: centerY
controls.label: Center Y
controls.description: Vertical ripple origin. Zero is the top edge and one is the bottom edge.

controls.name: travel
controls.label: Horizontal travel
controls.description: Horizontal movement of successive ripple origins, relative to the composition width.

controls.name: seed
controls.label: Seed
controls.description: Choose a repeatable arrangement of fluid distortion.

controls.name: borderRadius
controls.label: Border radius (px)
controls.description: Round the outer corners of the effect independently of the preview window.

controls.name: blur
controls.label: Ripple blur
controls.description: Blur each ripple before distortion. Rose Lagoon defaults to 0.035; the Original preset uses 0.05, corresponding to about 54 px in a 1080 px composition.

controls.name: distortion
controls.label: Distortion
controls.description: Bend the blurred ripples with fluid turbulence. Rose Lagoon uses zero distortion; the Original preset's 0.0133 corresponds to Amount 14.4 in a 1080 px composition.

controls.name: turbulenceScale
controls.label: Turbulence scale
controls.description: Size of the folds in the fluid distortion. The default corresponds to Turbulent Displace Size 100 in a 1080 px composition.

controls.name: refraction
controls.label: Wave height
controls.description: Strength of the broad luminous water ripples, corresponding to the tutorial's Caustics Water Wave Height.

controls.name: interactive
controls.label: Click interaction
controls.description: Click or tap the surface to emit a liquid ripple at that position. Foreground buttons, links, and inputs keep their own behavior.

controls.name: interactionStrength
controls.label: Click strength
controls.description: Strength of click and tap waves. Zero disables pointer emissions without affecting typing waves.

controls.name: palette
controls.label: Palette
controls.description: Gradient palette. Rose Lagoon is the default; Turquoise, Silk, Opal, Aurora, Rose, Glacier, Solar and Graphite are also available, and "auto" uses the original page-adaptive colors. The catalog applies palettes from its Preset menu.

controls.name: theme
controls.label: Theme
controls.description: Light keeps the palette's light colors on any page theme. Automatic follows the page theme, and Dark uses the palette's dark variation.

controls.name: backgroundColor
controls.label: Background color
controls.description: Automatic background color unless overridden. An empty string follows the selected palette and theme.

controls.name: blueColor
controls.label: Blue color
controls.description: Cool tint inside the fluid ripples. An empty string follows the selected palette and theme.

controls.name: lavenderColor
controls.label: Lavender color
controls.description: Soft secondary tint in the refracted folds. An empty string follows the selected palette and theme.

controls.name: highlightColor
controls.label: Highlight color
controls.description: Light reflected along the ripple ridges. An empty string follows the selected palette and theme.

controls.name: speed
controls.label: Speed
controls.description: Playback speed. Zero holds the current frame.

controls.name: phase
controls.label: Phase
controls.description: Starting point in the repeating ripple animation, from zero to one.

controls.name: paused
controls.label: Paused
controls.description: Hold the current frame and resume from the same position.

controls.name: maxFps
controls.label: Frame limit
controls.description: Maximum drawing rate. This does not change playback speed.

controls.name: resolutionScale
controls.label: Resolution scale
controls.description: Scale the drawing buffer to balance sharpness and GPU work.

controls.name: maxDpr
controls.label: Pixel ratio limit
controls.description: Limit the drawing resolution on high-density displays.

controls.name: maxPixels
controls.label: Pixel budget
controls.description: Maximum number of pixels in the drawing buffer.
